summary: For HTTP 504 or 503 during long API operations such as CasC restores, raise client_request_timeout and add route_annotations haproxy.router.openshift.io/timeout: 180s to the AAP CR (latest 2.6 operator), then check the route's annotations.
questions: How do I fix 504 Gateway Timeout on the AAP route?
How do I increase the OpenShift route timeout for AAP?
Configuration as Code restore times out after 30 seconds

answer_card.title: Increase the route timeout
answer_card.answer_md:
In the AnsibleAutomationPlatform YAML (latest 2.6 operator), raise `client_request_timeout` and:
```yaml
spec:
  route_annotations: |
    haproxy.router.openshift.io/timeout: 180s
```
Check Networking > Routes > annotations.
